fields.description:
Intake deduplication currently records `intake_start` ledger rows with targets derived from the ticket content digest plus repository. ADP writes comments and status changes back to the ticket during a run. Those write-backs alter the digest. A later watermark poll sees a changed ticket revision, computes a different target, misses the completed ledger row, and starts a duplicate after the active execution reaches a terminal state.

The fix must keep the watermark path intact. Content changes still surface tickets to intake. The intake ledger must decide whether a surfaced ticket is a duplicate by stable ticket identity, while `inv intake --retry` remains the deliberate operator path because it clears the `intake_start` ledger row before the next surfaced change.

Identity-based keys fit the existing side-effect ledger without a schema change. The ledger compatibility lookup runs during `reserve()` for `intake_start` and checks completed rows by task id, operation, and a parsed repository target suffix before inserting the new key. That reserve-time lookup covers prior digest-based rows and rolling deployment overlap. `services/orchestration/intake_retry.py` clears repo-scoped rows by matching a `:{repo}` target suffix, so the new target keeps the `{ticket_id}:{repo}` shape.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Intake start ledger targets use ticket identity plus repository, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k intake_start_dedup_key_uses_ticket_identity_and_repo`
- [x] Ticket write-back content changes after a terminal execution replay the completed intake record, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k ticket_writeback_change_after_terminal_execution_is_deduplicated`
- [x] Operator-requested intake retry can admit the ticket after the ledger record is cleared, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k cleared_intake_dedup_allows_operator_requested_rerun`
- [x] Prior digest-based intake ledger rows replay under the stable key during deployment, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_digest_based_intake_start_replays_for_the_same_ticket_repo`
- [x] Legacy pending intake rows create a current-key row before effects run, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_pending_intake_start_is_completed_under_the_current_key`
- [x] Legacy completed intake rows replay with the legacy key, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_completed_intake_start_replays_with_the_legacy_key`
- [x] Legacy completed intake rows for other repositories do not replay, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_completed_intake_start_for_a_different_repo_does_not_replay`
- [x] Legacy repo suffix matching treats underscores literally, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k legacy_intake_repo_match_treats_underscores_literally`
- [x] The rebar watermark poll still surfaces a never-run ticket when its status becomes admissible, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_rebar_intake_watermark.py -k ticket_that_becomes_admissible_later_is_still_seen`

- [x] A pending legacy intake record makes the in-memory ledger report the current key as reentrant, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k pending_legacy_intake_start_makes_the_current_key_reentrant`
- [x] A pending legacy intake record scoped to another repository leaves the in-memory ledger non-reentrant, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k pending_intake_start_for_a_different_repo_is_not_reentrant`
- [x] A pending legacy intake row makes the Postgres ledger report the current key as reentrant, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k pending_legacy_intake_start_row_makes_the_current_key_reentrant`
- [x] A pending legacy intake row scoped to another repository leaves the Postgres ledger non-reentrant, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k pending_legacy_intake_start_row_for_another_repo_is_not_reentrant`
- [x] The most recently updated legacy intake row decides the replay, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_coordination_idempotency.py -k the_most_recently_updated_legacy_intake_start_row_wins`

## Testing
Run each acceptance criterion selector on its own. Run `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/inv ci` before closing the ticket.
